title: Give every route and exposed journey a bound e2e proof at its canonical path

facts.note: Plan declarations and e2e test paths resolved from the topology settings (defaults plan, e2e); vendored/generated trees excluded.
Derived from topology roots in atdd-bun.yaml.

The atdd_topology validator must parse the plan (declared routes, exposed journeys and their surfaces, declared features, WMBT-declared acceptances) and the e2e tests (URN, Acceptance line, Train/Journey binding) and scan ALL declared routes/exposed journeys, changed or not.
Diff-level observer; only an early trigger — the obligation also holds for unchanged existing routes/journeys.
Task text mentions routes/journeys or e2e proofs.

fires: A plan-declared interlocking route — new or long-existing and untouched — has no `<e2e_root>/interlockings/<interlocking>/<route>.routes.test.ts`.
An exposed journey has no `<e2e_root>/journeys/<journey>.journey.test.ts`, and (if its surfaces include `frontend`) no qualifying Playwright spec either.

For an interlocking route, a non-frontend exposed journey, or a frontend exposed journey that has no qualifying Playwright substitute: the Bun test at the canonical path carries no `test:{wagon}:{feature}:{acceptance}` URN, or its URN names a feature that is not declared.

For an interlocking route, a non-frontend exposed journey, or a frontend exposed journey that has no qualifying Playwright substitute: the Bun test at the canonical path has no `Acceptance: acc:{wagon}:{acceptance}` binding, or binds one that no WMBT declares.

A Playwright spec is the only proof relied on for a frontend exposed journey (no qualifying Bun test at the canonical path) and it lacks a `// Train:`/`// Journey:` binding, is bound to a different subject than its URN, or lacks a valid E2E/SMOKE URN for that subject.
A Playwright spec is the only proof relied on for an exposed journey whose surfaces do not include `frontend`.
doesNotFire: Files under vendored or generated trees (`node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated`).
Wagon-level tests under `<test_root>` unrelated to any declared route or exposed journey.

A frontend exposed journey proven by a Playwright spec bound via `// Train:` (the route's train) or `// Journey:` (the journey) and carrying a valid E2E/SMOKE URN for that same subject — even if a nonqualifying Bun file also exists at the canonical path.
A Playwright spec that is not relied on as the substitute because the route/journey already has a qualifying Bun test at its canonical path (this rule does not judge such extra browser specs).

given: The plan declares an interlocking route or exposed journey (new or existing, changed or not)
when: you change code or tests, or atdd_topology reports `atdd-bun.topology.e2e-location`
then: Ensure it has a test at `<e2e_root>/interlockings/<interlocking>/<route>.routes.test.ts` (route) or `<e2e_root>/journeys/<journey>.journey.test.ts` (journey) carrying a `test:{wagon}:{feature}:{acceptance}` URN for a declared feature AND binding `Acceptance: acc:{wagon}:{acceptance}` declared by a WMBT; a file lacking either does not count.
prefer: Add the test at exactly the path the finding names.
Copy feature and acceptance ids from the plan's declarations.
avoid: Ad-hoc e2e locations found only by searching.
Undeclared features in URNs; Acceptance ids no WMBT declares; empty files at the path.
An `Acceptance:` line in a browser journey spec (`tester.htmx.journey-no-acceptance-marker`).
unless: Exposed journey with `frontend` surface: a Playwright `*.e2e.ts` spec substitutes when bound via `// Train:` (route's train) or `// Journey:` and carrying a valid E2E/SMOKE URN for that same subject (`test:train:<id>:E2E-NNN-…`, `test:journey:<id>:SMOKE-NNN-…`) instead of an `Acceptance:` line.
why: One behaviour, one end-to-end proof at a path derived from the plan: a missing proof is found by path, not by searching.
evidence: For every plan-declared interlocking route, `<e2e_root>/interlockings/<interlocking>/<route>.routes.test.ts` exists.

For every exposed journey, `<e2e_root>/journeys/<journey>.journey.test.ts` exists, or (frontend surface) a `*.e2e.ts` spec bound by `// Train:`/`// Journey:` with a valid E2E/SMOKE URN for that same subject.
Each Bun e2e test relied on as the proof carries a `test:{wagon}:{feature}:{acceptance}` URN for a declared feature and an `Acceptance: acc:{wagon}:{acceptance}` declared by a WMBT.
No browser journey spec contains an `Acceptance:` line.
The atdd_topology validator reports no `atdd-bun.topology.e2e-location` finding.
verifier_detail: Paths resolve from the `topology:` keys in `atdd-bun.yaml`: `plan_root`, `source_root`, `test_root`, `e2e_root` (defaults `plan`, `src/wagons`, `tests/wagons`, `e2e`).

Route path: `<e2e_root>/interlockings/<interlocking>/<route>.routes.test.ts`; journey path: `<e2e_root>/journeys/<journey>.journey.test.ts`. Check every declared route/exposed journey, not only changed ones.

Bun test identity: URN `test:{wagon}:{feature}:{acceptance}` with the feature declared; `Acceptance: acc:{wagon}:{acceptance}` must be declared by a WMBT. A file at the path without both is a finding — unconditionally for interlocking routes and non-frontend exposed journeys; for frontend exposed journeys only when no qualifying Playwright substitute exists.

Playwright substitution only for exposed journeys whose surfaces include `frontend`: `*.e2e.ts` bound via `// Train:` (route's train) or `// Journey:` (the journey) and carrying `test:train:<id>:E2E-NNN-…` or `test:journey:<id>:SMOKE-NNN-…` for that same subject. Evaluate these qualifications only when the spec is relied on as the substitute (no qualifying Bun test at the canonical path).
Browser specs are identified by the URN instead of an `Acceptance:` line; `tester.htmx.journey-no-acceptance-marker` forbids `Acceptance:` on journey specs.
audit: Term package_rule: a rule of this package's own gates (`atdd-bun.*`), realized by a package guard rather than a canonical planner node. It is held to the same per-rule checks as every convention: a convention, strict, a failing fixture, relationship edges.
Source name: Every interlocking route and exposed journey has an end-to-end test at its canonical path
Summary: Every interlocking route and exposed journey has an end-to-end test at its canonical path.
Fix hint (source): Add the test at the path the finding names, or, on a frontend journey, a Playwright spec bound with `// Train:` or `// Journey:`.

sharedNodes.text: Strict: the rule fails on every finding.

additions.text: No split: the source states one obligation — a qualifying e2e proof per route/exposed journey — whose necessary qualifications are canonical path, declared-feature URN and WMBT-declared Acceptance binding (or, for frontend journeys, the bound Playwright substitute). All are in `then`/`unless` as mandatory.
additions.justification: Auditor: URN and Acceptance requirements must keep mandatory force, not be a preference or an unimplemented split.

additions.text: Copy feature and acceptance ids from the plan's declarations rather than inventing them.
additions.justification: Reviewer usability risk: coders guessing identifiers; this is the direct way to satisfy the source's 'declared feature' / 'declared by a WMBT' conditions, adds no obligation.

additions.text: Activation facts and fires/doesNotFire scenarios; Bun URN/Acceptance findings fire unconditionally for interlocking routes and non-frontend exposed journeys, and for frontend exposed journeys only when no qualifying Playwright substitute exists; Playwright qualifications are evaluated only when the spec is relied on as the substitute; extra browser specs alongside a qualifying Bun test are out of scope.
additions.justification: Required structure; auditor required narrowing the fires to failed substitution so compliant frontend journeys are not flagged.

additions.text: The `…` suffix of E2E/SMOKE URNs is kept as in the source; the source does not define it further.
additions.justification: Reviewer flagged the ellipsis; no format is invented.

additions.text: Coder-facing text exceeds ~1,000 chars because canonical paths, URN formats and the substitution conditions must stay verbatim.
